subject: Fix rename REDIS_TEST to SERVER_TEST to pass the Daily workflow (#131)
reason: The change only renames the REDIS_TEST compile-time macro to SERVER_TEST in #ifdef guards around embedded unit-test code (and one test-only struct field in quicklist.c). That macro is defined only in special test builds via the Makefile/CI; in the ordinary builds the fuzzer runs, all guarded code is compiled out on both the parent and the change, so the two builds are behaviourally identical. This is a build/CI fix with no runtime behaviour to exercise, so no scenario is needed.
